blocking.title: The landings bar's outcome contradicts what happened and the order news beside it: 'lost at sea' for divisions alive on land, 'landed' for a landing that broke off
blocking.evidence: 22103 (GER Berlin->Norwich, transports sunk t90 while marching): row 'over: lost at sea', news 'the transports of their landing were sunk ... the landing is over', both divisions inland (critic/c52_lland_ger_norwich_22103.json, critic/shots/c52lland_ger_norwich_22103_over_1500m.png). 3517 (run 50's case): 'over: 2 landed, 1 lost at sea' with 366 alive on land (critic/c52_lost_desk.json afterSink, critic/shots/c52lost_desk_rows.png; also critic/shots/c51lost_desk_rows.png). 21105 (run 51's Malta case): 'over: 2 landed' while news says 'its transports broke off; it came ashore away from its target' and they stand on Sicily (critic/c52_lland_ita_malta_21105.json, critic/shots/c52lland_ita_malta_21105_over_1500m.png). Cause: src/worker/server.ts tally since 760140ff (R47a): TransportsSunk counted as lost, every FormationLanded as landed. landingRows' outcome check compares with the same tally (0 broken).
blocking.fix: Word the over row from each division's state as the order news does ('transports sunk; 2 stay ashore', 'broke off; 2 came ashore near Palermo'; 'lost at sea' only for those dead at sea); make landingRows' outcome check read the divisions, red before on 22103, 3517 and 21105.
